name: Pioneer Bankshares, Inc.
summary: Pioneer Bankshares, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for Pioneer Bank, Inc. that provides various banking and related financial services to individual consumers, small to medium size businesses, and professional community in the United States. The company offers various deposit products, which include business and personal checking accounts, savings accounts, and time and money market accounts. It also provides personal loans comprising personal installment and single-pay, and auto loans; business loans consisting of operating capital, lines of credit, equipment loans, business expansion, investment properties, and property acquisition or construction; home mortgage and home equity loans. In addition, the company offers credit and debit cards, safe deposit boxes, online and mobile banking tools, fraud monitoring, ATMs, telephone banking, wire transfers, autobooks, cash management, automated clearing house, remote deposit capture, merchant services, and online services, as well as Zelle for sending money. Further, it provides wealth investment services, such as individual retirement accounts, college savings plans, small business investment strategies, and fixed and variable annuities; and securities and insurance products and services. Pioneer Bankshares, Inc. was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Stanley, Virginia.
